description: This file contains the implementation of the AzureTableGrainStorage class, which provides mechanisms for storing, reading, and deleting grain state data in Azure Table Storage within the Orleans framework. It manages serialization, size constraints, and optimistic concurrency, and includes lifecycle management and logging features.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainStorage
classes.description: Implements grain storage using Azure Table Storage with support for serialization, size policies, optimistic concurrency, and lifecycle participation.

classes.name: AzureTableGrainStorage.GrainStateTableDataManager
classes.description: Manages individual Azure Table Storage table interactions such as reading, writing, and deleting table entities, including detailed logging.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Reads the grain state data from Azure Table Storage into provided grain state object.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Writes the grain state data to Azure Table Storage, handling ETag for optimistic concurrency.

methods.name: ClearStateAsync
methods.description: Clears or deletes the grain state data from Azure Table Storage based on configuration.

methods.name: ConvertToStorageFormat
methods.description: Serializes grain state into Azure table entity properties, splitting data into chunks if necessary.

methods.name: ConvertFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Deserializes stored Azure table entity data back into grain state.

methods.name: GetKeyString
methods.description: Constructs a sanitized partition key string based on cluster service ID and grain ID.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the storage provider, creating the table data manager.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the storage provider, nullifying the table data manager reference.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage provider to silo lifecycle events.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a grain state serializer activator.
